svg.title: The workflow editor
svg.desc: The AI builds a workflow from one sentence. A person drags an HTTP step from the palette and connects it. A dry test run marks each step and gives a preview for the HTTP step. The assistant proposes a human approval step before the refund. The person accepts it, the locked reply step stays, and the draft is saved as a version.
svg.text: The workflow editor: build an agent with AI, then edit it like an n8n workflow
The AI builds the graph from one sentence. You drag steps, test them in a dry run, ask the assistant for changes, and keep each version.

g.text: ✦ Built by AI: “Answer questions by email. Send refunds to the API.”
Dry run: the HTTP step gives a preview. No data goes out.
The locked step did not change.
✓ Saved as version 4 · versions diff · three-way merge on conflict

svg.text: The AI and you edit the same JSON graph. The compiler checks each change. A dry run sends nothing out. Locked steps stay as they are.
